title: Everyone Begs From You, And All Offer
summary: Ego is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day
evidence.turn: Ego steadies when all praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened.
evidence.practicalImplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
